description: Dedicated entries for Hollow's End facilities, lodging, drink, and emergency resources.

entries.title: Hollow's End Hearth
entries.summary: A magically sustained stone hearth keeps Hollow's End warm despite high-altitude winds and storms.
body: The massive fireplace dominates the common room of [[hollows-end-tavern|Hollow's End Tavern]]. Its fire never fully dies, even when fierce winds sweep the edge of [[dunhallow-roost|Dunhallow Roost]].
The dependable warmth helps make the tavern a refuge and gathering place rather than merely a remote drinking house.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Hollow's End / Cozy Hearth and Firepit

entries.title: Hollow's End Sending Station
entries.summary: Crystal charging docks make the remote tavern an important communications stop for passing travelers.
body: A reinforced table near the bar holds enchanted docks used to recharge sending stones for a fee. This service connects an isolated tavern to the communication needs of merchants, travelers, agents, and crews.
The station also creates opportunities for surveillance and misuse, particularly under the attention of [[zara-hollows-end|Zara]] and visitors who occupy a dock for suspicious lengths of time.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Hollow's End / Charging Station for Sending Stones

entries.title: The Applewood Cellar
entries.summary: A magically cooled cellar stores Hollow's End alcohol, sky-apple brandy, and concealed emergency material.
body: The cellar beneath [[hollows-end-tavern|Hollow's End Tavern]] holds a notable reserve of drink, especially apple brandy produced from rare high-altitude sky-apples.

Its storage capacity makes the tavern unusually resilient for a remote establishment. [[killain-red-omara|Killain Red O'Mara]] also uses the cellar to conceal repair supplies reserved for crews in genuine need.

entries.title: Hollow's End Lodging Huts
entries.summary: Three sturdy huts provide deluxe, standard, and communal lodging beside Hollow's End Tavern.
body: The huts offer private shelter separate from the tavern's common room. One contains a large deluxe bed, another provides two standard beds, and the economy hut holds six plank bunks.
Each room includes a chest for possessions, giving travelers a rare opportunity for rest and storage along the lesser-used route through [[dunhallow-roost|Dunhallow Roost]].

entries.title: Red's Ember Brandy
entries.summary: Killain's cinnamon-apple liquor is prized for its smooth warmth and alerting effect.
body: [[killain-red-omara|Killain Red O'Mara]] serves this signature drink at [[hollows-end-tavern|Hollow's End Tavern]]. It is made in the local apple-brandy tradition and stored in the [[applewood-cellar|Applewood Cellar]].
Travelers value the drink for warming the body in high-altitude cold and sharpening attention before returning to difficult skies.

sections.heading: Legacy Drink Effect
body: The source grants advantage on the next Wisdom check within an hour. This numerical procedure requires conversion.

entries.title: Red's Hidden Repair Cache
entries.summary: A concealed stock of airship repair materials is offered only to crews Killain judges truly desperate.
body: [[killain-red-omara|Killain Red O'Mara]] keeps repair material hidden beneath [[hollows-end-tavern|Hollow's End Tavern]]. The cache reflects his years aboard tithe, merchant, and pirate vessels as well as his commitment to preserving the tavern as a refuge.

The supplies are not ordinary shop inventory. Access depends on genuine need and Killain's trust, allowing him to save stranded crews without advertising a resource that pirates, officials, or profiteers would seize.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Hollow's End / Killain's Hidden Repair Materials
